description: This file contains a PHP class definition for the BankTransfer payment controller in the OpenCart e-commerce system. It manages the display and processing of bank transfer payment instructions during checkout and order confirmation.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Controller class for handling bank transfer payment method in the OpenCart extension system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the bank transfer payment page with instructions and bank details.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the confirmation of the bank transfer payment, updating order status and redirecting to success page.
